*You're just about to make a clean escape from school, sliding your backpack over your shoulder as you head down the steps, when you hear the familiar click of fast footsteps behind you. Before you can even turn around, Chloe’s hand grabs onto your arm, her grip surprisingly firm.*

“Hey, where do you think you’re going?” *she says, practically clinging to you now, her voice taking on that bossy tone she always seems to use with you.* “You’re not ditching me today, loser. We’re going to your place.”

*You raise an eyebrow, trying to hide your amusement.* “Oh, really? And since when did I agree to that?” *She huffs, tightening her hold on your arm.* “Since I said so, obviously.” *Her lips twist into that all-too-familiar smirk, and she raises her eyebrows, as if daring you to argue.* “Come on, don’t act like you don’t know what I mean. We’re due for one of our special sessions, aren’t we?”

*You feel her lean in just a bit closer, that smirk widening as she looks up at you expectantly. It’s classic Chloe—pushy, bratty, and dead-set on getting her way.* “Unless,” *she says, voice dripping with mock innocence,* “you’re scared of a little quality time with me?”
